coachView.name: MarkdownViewer
coachView.layout:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><ns2:layout xmlns:ns2="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/CoachDesignerNG" xmlns:ns3="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/coachview"><ns2:layoutItem xsi:type="ns2:CustomHTML" version="8550" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><ns2:id>d6ef10fb-cc82-4ac3-b5b2-59ec360b30d0</ns2:id><ns2:layoutItemId>CustomHTML1</ns2:layoutItemId><ns2:configData><ns2:id>80417ccd-aa81-4212-9840-d57c9fb5d315</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.contentType</ns2:optionName><ns2:value>TEXT</ns2:value></ns2:configData><ns2:configData><ns2:id>4afaea88-54a9-4fdc-a3f0-439a7414f54a</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.textContent</ns2:optionName><ns2:value><div class="markdown-viewer-container" role="article" aria-label="Markdown content viewer">

coachView.description: A widget for rendering markdown-formatted text into styled HTML content with support for headers, lists, code blocks, tables, and more

configOption.name: enableSanitization
configOption.label: Enable HTML Sanitization
configOption.description: Enable HTML sanitization to prevent XSS attacks. When enabled, HTML tags in the markdown will be escaped

configOption.name: showLineNumbers
configOption.label: Show Line Numbers
configOption.description: Display line numbers alongside the rendered content. Useful for code documentation or technical content

configOption.name: theme
configOption.label: Theme
configOption.description: Visual theme for the markdown viewer (default, light, or dark)

configOption.name: onContentChange
configOption.label: On Content Change
configOption.description: Triggered when the markdown content is rendered or updated
